CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION academy_private.notice_content_for(p academy_profiles, c academy_content)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when academy_private.is_operations_director(p.id) then c.published else coalesce(p.status='active' and c.published
 and (c.restaurant_id is null or c.restaurant_id=p.restaurant_id)
 and (c.department is null or c.department=p.department)
 and (c.kind<>'menu' or c.payload->>'brand'=case when p.restaurant_id='minsk' then 'rvb' when p.restaurant_id in ('pushkino','khimki','mytishchi') then '90' end)
 and (c.kind<>'material' or coalesce(c.payload->>'brand','common') in ('common',case when p.restaurant_id='minsk' then 'rvb' else '90' end))
 and (not c.payload ? 'audiencePositions' or c.payload->'audiencePositions' ? p.position)
 and (not c.payload ? 'audienceLevels' or p.department='Руководитель' or c.payload->'audienceLevels' ? p.training_level)
 and (c.course_id is null or exists(select 1 from public.academy_content parent where parent.id=c.course_id and parent.published
 and (parent.restaurant_id is null or parent.restaurant_id=p.restaurant_id) and (parent.department is null or parent.department=p.department)
 and (not parent.payload ? 'audiencePositions' or parent.payload->'audiencePositions' ? p.position))),false) end
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 where c.id=p_course_id and c.kind='course' and coalesce(l.item->>'id',(l.idx-1)::text)=p_lesson_id)

 on conflict(user_id,course_id,lesson_id) do nothing;

functions.name: academy_ranking
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.academy_ranking()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with actor as (
 select * from public.academy_profiles where id=auth.uid() and status='active'
 ), visible as (
 select p.* from public.academy_profiles p cross join actor a where p.status='active' and
 (a.role='admin' or a.operations_director or (a.role='manager' and p.restaurant_id=a.restaurant_id and p.department=a.department)
 or (a.role='employee' and p.restaurant_id=a.restaurant_id))
 ), best as (
 select a.user_id,a.test_id,max(a.score::numeric/nullif(a.total,0)) filter(where not a.needs_review) as fraction,
 bool_or(a.passed) as passed from public.academy_attempts a join visible p on p.id=a.user_id
 where a.submitted_at is not null and (coalesce((a.snapshot->>'timeLimitSeconds')::integer,0)=0
 or a.submitted_at<=a.started_at+make_interval(secs=>(a.snapshot->>'timeLimitSeconds')::integer+10))
 group by a.user_id,a.test_id
 ), scores as (
 select user_id,round(avg(fraction)*100,1) as average_score,count(*) as tests_attempted,count(*) filter(where passed) as tests_passed
 from best group by user_id
 ), lessons as (
 select p.user_id,count(*) as lessons_completed from public.academy_progress p join visible v on v.id=p.user_id group by p.user_id
 ), marks as (
 select m.user_id,count(*) filter(where m.status='learned') as menu_learned,count(*) filter(where m.status='repeat') as menu_repeat
 from public.academy_menu_marks m join visible v on v.id=m.user_id group by m.user_id
 )
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('user_id',p.id,'full_name',p.full_name,'restaurant_id',p.restaurant_id,
 'department',p.department,'position',p.position,'average_score',s.average_score,
 'tests_attempted',coalesce(s.tests_attempted,0),'tests_passed',coalesce(s.tests_passed,0),
 'lessons_completed',coalesce(l.lessons_completed,0),'menu_learned',coalesce(m.menu_learned,0),'menu_repeat',coalesce(m.menu_repeat,0))
 order by s.average_score desc nulls last,coalesce(s.tests_passed,0) desc,p.full_name),'[]'::jsonb)
 from visible p left join scores s on s.user_id=p.id left join lessons l on l.user_id=p.id left join marks m on m.user_id=p.id
$function$

functions.name: academy_manager_dashboard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.academy_manager_dashboard()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select jsonb_build_object(
 'profiles',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(p),'[]') from public.academy_profiles p),
 'attempts',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(a),'[]') from public.academy_attempts a),
 'progress',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(p),'[]') from public.academy_progress p),
 'menu_marks',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(m),'[]') from public.academy_menu_marks m),
 'menu_stats',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x),'[]') from (
 select p.id as user_id,count(c.id) as total,count(m.item_id) filter(where m.status='learned') as learned,
 count(m.item_id) filter(where m.status='repeat') as repeat,
 count(c.id)-count(m.item_id) filter(where m.status in ('learned','repeat')) as not_started
 from public.academy_profiles p left join public.academy_content c on c.kind='menu' and c.published and (c.department is null or c.department=p.department) and c.payload->>'menuSection' in ('bar','kitchen') and
 (c.restaurant_id=p.restaurant_id or (c.restaurant_id is null and c.payload->>'brand'=case
 when p.restaurant_id='minsk' then 'rvb' when p.restaurant_id in ('pushkino','khimki','mytishchi') then '90' else '' end))
 left join public.academy_menu_marks m on m.user_id=p.id and m.item_id=c.id group by p.id
 ) x))
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION academy_private.general_training_status(p_user uuid, p_restaurant text, p_department text, p_position text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with required_courses as (
 select c.* from public.academy_content c where c.kind='course' and c.published
 and (c.restaurant_id is null or c.restaurant_id=p_restaurant) and (c.department is null or c.department=p_department)
 and (not c.payload ? 'audiencePositions' or c.payload->'audiencePositions' ? p_position)
 and (not c.payload ? 'requiredRestaurantIds' or c.payload->'requiredRestaurantIds' ? p_restaurant)
 and coalesce(c.payload->'venueAudiencePriorities'->p_restaurant->>p_position,c.payload->'audiencePriorities'->>p_position,c.payload->>'priority','additional') in ('start','attestation')
), required_tests as (
 select t.* from public.academy_content t where t.kind='test' and t.published
 and (t.restaurant_id is null or t.restaurant_id=p_restaurant) and (t.department is null or t.department=p_department)
 and (not t.payload ? 'audiencePositions' or t.payload->'audiencePositions' ? p_position)
 and (not t.payload ? 'requiredRestaurantIds' or t.payload->'requiredRestaurantIds' ? p_restaurant)
 and (exists(select 1 from required_courses c where c.id=t.course_id) or
 (t.course_id is null and coalesce(t.payload->>'priority','attestation') in ('start','attestation')))
), test_status as (
 select t.id,t.title,t.course_id,exists(select 1 from public.academy_attempts a where a.user_id=p_user and a.test_id=t.id and a.submitted_at is not null and a.passed and not a.needs_review and a.total>0 and
 (coalesce((a.snapshot->>'timeLimitSeconds')::integer,0)=0 or a.submitted_at<=a.started_at+make_interval(secs=>(a.snapshot->>'timeLimitSeconds')::integer+10))) as passed from required_tests t
), course_status as (
 select c.id,c.title,coalesce(c.payload->'venueAudiencePriorities'->p_restaurant->>p_position,c.payload->'audiencePriorities'->>p_position,c.payload->>'priority','additional') as priority,
 (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(c.payload->'lessons')='array' then c.payload->'lessons' else '[]'::jsonb end)) as total,
 (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(c.payload->'lessons')='array' then c.payload->'lessons' else '[]'::jsonb end) with ordinality l(value,n) where exists(select 1 from public.academy_progress p where p.user_id=p_user and p.course_id=c.id and p.lesson_id=coalesce(l.value->>'id',(l.n-1)::text))) as done,
 (select count(*) from test_status t where t.course_id=c.id) as tests_total,
 (select count(*) from test_status t where t.course_id=c.id and t.passed) as tests_passed
 from required_courses c
), completed_courses as (
 select c.*,((total>0 or tests_total>0) and done=total and tests_total=tests_passed) as complete from course_status c
)
select jsonb_build_object('passed',((select count(*) from completed_courses)+(select count(*) from test_status)>0 and not exists(select 1 from completed_courses where not complete) and not exists(select 1 from test_status where not passed)),
 'courses_total',(select count(*) from completed_courses),'courses_completed',(select count(*) from completed_courses where complete),
 'tests_total',(select count(*) from test_status),'tests_passed',(select count(*) from test_status where passed),
 'courses',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) order by case c.priority when 'start' then 0 else 1 end,c.title) from completed_courses c),'[]'::jsonb),
 'tests',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.title) from test_status t),'[]'::jsonb))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION academy_private.notification_work_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare p public.academy_profiles;
begin
 if tg_op='INSERT' then
 perform academy_private.emit_notice(new.user_id,'work-request:'||new.id,'account','Заявка на перевод отправлена',new.department||' · '||new.position,'#/profile');
 for p in select * from public.academy_profiles where status='active' and id<>new.user_id and (role='admin' or role='manager' and new.original_role='employee' and restaurant_id=new.restaurant_id and department=new.department) loop
 -- Receiving administrator can already read this request via academy_work_change_list.
 perform academy_private.emit_notice(p.id,'work-review:'||new.id,'work_review','Заявка на смену рабочих данных',new.full_name||' · '||new.position,'#/manager','work',new.user_id);end loop;
 elsif new.status is distinct from old.status then
 perform academy_private.emit_notice(new.user_id,'work-result:'||new.id||':'||new.status,'account',case new.status when 'approved' then 'Перевод подтверждён' when 'rejected' then 'Заявка на перевод отклонена' else 'Заявка на перевод отменена' end,new.department||' · '||new.position,'#/profile');end if;return null;
end $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION academy_private.notify_readiness(m academy_profiles)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare g jsonb;v_division text;recipient public.academy_profiles;
begin
 if m.status<>'active' or m.position<>'Официант' or m.restaurant_id is null then return;end if;
 g:=academy_private.general_training_status(m.id,m.restaurant_id,m.department,m.position);
 if not (g->>'passed')::boolean then return;end if;
 foreach v_division in array array['kitchen','bar'] loop
 if not coalesce((select a.passed from public.academy_oral_assessments a where a.employee_id=m.id and a.restaurant_id=m.restaurant_id and a.division=v_division order by a.created_at desc,a.id desc limit 1),false) then
 for recipient in select * from public.academy_profiles where status='active' and id<>m.id and
 (role='admin' or role='manager' and restaurant_id=m.restaurant_id and ((v_division='kitchen' and department='Кухня' and position='Шеф-повар') or (v_division='bar' and department='Бар' and position='Бар-менеджер'))) loop
 perform academy_private.emit_notice(recipient.id,'oral-ready:'||m.id||':'||m.restaurant_id||':'||v_division,'attestation','Сотрудник готов к аттестации · '||case v_division when 'bar' then 'Бар' else 'Кухня' end,m.full_name||' завершил обязательное обучение.','#/attestation/members/'||m.id||'?division='||v_division,'oral',m.id);end loop;end if;end loop;
end $function$

functions.name: academy_announce_content
academy_notifications
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.academy_notifications(p_limit integer DEFAULT 30, p_unread boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare p public.academy_profiles;r jsonb;
begin
 select * into p from public.academy_profiles where id=auth.uid();if p.id is null then raise exception 'Войдите в аккаунт.';end if;
 perform academy_private.refresh_notices(p);
 select jsonb_build_object('as_of',clock_timestamp(),'unread',(select count(*) from academy_private.notifications n where n.read_at is null and academy_private.notice_visible(n,p)),
 'total',(select count(*) from academy_private.notifications n where academy_private.notice_visible(n,p) and (not p_unread or n.read_at is null)),
 'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.created_at desc,x.id desc) from
 (select n.id,n.category,n.title,n.body,n.route,n.created_at,n.read_at,
 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'title',c.title,'kind',c.kind) order by c.title) from public.academy_content c where c.id=any(n.content_ids) and academy_private.notice_content_for(p,c)),'[]'::jsonb) as targets
 from academy_private.notifications n where academy_private.notice_visible(n,p) and (not p_unread or n.read_at is null) order by n.created_at desc,n.id desc limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,30),200))) x),'[]'::jsonb)) into r;return r;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION academy_private.notice_visible(n academy_private.notifications, p academy_profiles)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select n.user_id=p.id and case n.scope when 'own' then true when 'content' then
 exists(select 1 from public.academy_content c where c.id=any(n.content_ids) and academy_private.notice_content_for(p,c))
 when 'team' then p.status='active' and exists(select 1 from public.academy_profiles m where m.id=n.subject_id and
 (p.role='admin' or p.operations_director or p.role='manager' and m.role='employee' and p.restaurant_id=m.restaurant_id and p.department=m.department))
 when 'work' then p.status='active' and exists(select 1 from public.academy_work_changes r where r.id::text=split_part(n.event_key,':',2) and r.user_id<>p.id and
 (p.role='admin' or p.operations_director or p.role='manager' and r.original_role='employee' and p.restaurant_id=r.restaurant_id and p.department=r.department))
 when 'oral' then p.status='active' and exists(select 1 from public.academy_profiles m where m.id=n.subject_id and
 (p.role='admin' or p.operations_director or p.role='manager' and p.restaurant_id=m.restaurant_id and ((p.department='Кухня' and p.position='Шеф-повар') or (p.department='Бар' and p.position='Бар-менеджер'))))
 else false end
$function$
